items.hazard: Wrong task, fluid or connection; other work interfering.
items.controls: READ: Confirm task, fluid/SDS, asset, flow path, return and permits. CREW CHECK: Describe the job in one sentence; have the representative identify the connection and return. Say what is different today.

steps.title: 02 - Where do we stand if something releases?

items.hazard: Vapors reaching ignition, traffic and blocked escape.
items.controls: READ: Use agreed separation and wind-aware layout. Protect lines and escape. Locate extinguishers and controls. CREW CHECK: Point to wind indicator, safe operating position, escape and muster. State the alarm/contact method.

steps.title: 03 - What could the air do to us?

items.hazard: H2S, flammable vapor, oxygen hazards and unsuitable PPE.
items.controls: READ: Apply site testing/monitoring, detector checks and alarm response. Never judge H2S by smell. Resolve PPE and respiratory needs. CREW CHECK: State the gas/PPE requirements and what everyone does at an alarm.

steps.title: 04 - Show the weak point before pressure does

items.hazard: Failed connection, line whip, overpressure and heat damage.
items.controls: READ: Inspect rated components, restraints, exclusion area, relief/check-valve arrangement and approved test results. CREW CHECK: Identify the lowest allowable system rating, its source, pressure/temperature limits, and where people must not stand.

steps.title: 05 - Talk through the start and stop

items.hazard: Ignition, hot release, lost return/flow or failed protection.
items.controls: READ: Follow the unit operating procedure. Verify fitted protection; do not bypass it. Stop for leaks, abnormal conditions or lost flow/return. CREW CHECK: Point to emergency stop and explain the safe leak/alarm response, flow limits and communication method.

steps.title: 06 - Prove it is safe before breaking a line

items.hazard: Stored pressure, residual heat, injection injury and spills.
items.controls: READ: Use approved cooldown, isolation and controlled bleed. Verify every trapped section is depressurized; never hammer live unions or check leaks by hand. Injection injury needs immediate medical attention. CREW CHECK: Name the person verifying zero energy and safe temperature. Confirm drainage capture, final valve status and handback.

ppeItems.label: PPE selected for this job: FR clothing, eye/face, hand/foot/head and hearing protection as assessed.
Site-required gas detection is ready and checked; respiratory protection requirements are resolved.

preparedItems.label: This is a software-review draft; it does not authorize hot-oiler work.
